notes: Fourth dispatch, from commit 192ea50. The third build (3f7e2f1) passed a static protobuf to MIGraphX, but CMake found the shared protobuf config first because the Python onnx package propagates it, so libmigraphx_tf still linked libprotobuf.so and the collision with OpenCV remained (verified: import cv2 then a MIGraphX session still aborts on tensor_shape.proto). 192ea50 sets protobuf_DIR so config lookup and protoc come from the static build. Rebuilds migraphx, onnxruntime, its wheel, frigate and downstream packages; expect about ninety minutes. Verify before activation: patchelf --print-needed on libmigraphx_tf must list no libprotobuf, and the detector-shaped smoke test as the frigate user from / (import cv2 and frigate.detectors, then a MIGraphX session on yolov8s.onnx) must report MIGraphXExecutionProvider first and infer in under 10 ms. Then make test-ser8. Build took about 35 minutes. Activation (make test-ser8) is the operator step that remains.

terminal_details.smoke: libmigraphx_tf and libmigraphx_onnx list no libprotobuf. As the frigate user from /, import cv2 or frigate.detectors then a MIGraphX session: both OK, providers [MIGraphX, CPU]. Detector-shaped timing: session load 1 s from the warmed cache, median 6.05 ms, p95 6.86 ms, max 17.15 ms on 200 runs. Importing tensorflow before the session still crashes the process; the detector process never imports it. The compiled model is cached at /var/lib/frigate/model_cache/migraphx. No new GPU resets.
